gitCommit.subject: fix(session): coordinate Resume/Set-aside busy state + align active heading (#252)
gitCommit.body:
fix(session): coordinate Resume/Set-aside busy state + align active heading (#252)

Two cleanup nits from the #251 whole-branch review (finished inline, not deferred):
- The paused collection card's Set aside stayed enabled while the ResumeControl
  PATCH was in flight — a curator could DELETE mid-resume (same row). ResumeControl
  now reports busy via an optional onBusyChange; the panel disables Set aside while
  a resume is in flight. Test pins it.
- Align the collection card's active heading 'Active Sorting Session' -> 'Active
  Session' to match the sort landing (one voice across the two surfaces).


Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
